title: KID-FEED-SAFETY pin candidate, not an installation
note: This manifest does not copy, restart, or install anything on the hub. Alfred must gate a new pin before any operational file is replaced.
behavior: Provider and therapy titles are dropped before school or other classification.
There is no provider opt-in. A clinical source item is dropped whole, never renamed.
Embedded clock ranges are removed from child titles. The row clock stays the source start.
cal-from-events shortPlace returns empty for a denied title and does not keep the raw sentence.
